base_commit_note: The PR was rebased before merge — the parent of merge commit d60457a6673cf0263213c2f2be02c633ec2e2038 is 850aefc2c651110a784cd5478af9774b1f6287a3 (2021-12-09, 'bpo-46063: Add delay=True to file handler initialization (GH-30103)'); solution.patch / eval_tests.patch apply cleanly there but not at the PR-creation-time tip. Same pattern as PEP-617 / PEP-634.
omitted_patch_note: INFORMATIONAL ARTIFACT ONLY — not byte-identical to the upstream PR's raw diff and not fully applyable. Two reasons: (a) the NEWS-file path contains a literal space ('Core and Builtins'); the split script renders it with git's standard quoting (`diff --git "a/Misc/.../...rst" "b/Misc/.../...rst"`), whereas pr_files_cache's `patch` field has the unquoted body. The content is preserved; only the header quoting differs. (b) Two roles in omitted.patch: (i) the 4 doc/NEWS files (Doc/library/ast.rst, Doc/library/dis.rst, Doc/whatsnew/3.11.rst, the NEWS rst); (ii) 3 test files (test_grammar.py, test_exception_variations.py, test_sys_settrace.py) whose PR modifications add literal except* syntax in test method bodies. Applying those via eval_tests.patch would cause the Python parser at pre-state to SyntaxError on module-load, ERROR-ing out every test in those files including the P2P candidates we draw from test_grammar.py. Moving them to omitted.patch keeps the files unmodified at both states. PEP 654's except* surface is amply covered by Lib/test/test_except_star.py (49 F2P methods).
solution_patch_note: Parser/parser.c (+2770/-1826 lines, the regenerated PEG parser table) has an empty patch field in pr_files_cache because the GitHub API truncates very large diffs; the canonical content was reconstructed via `git diff 850aefc2..d60457a6 -- Parser/parser.c` on the local clone. Same fix as PEP-617's parse.c and PEP-634's parser.c.

out_of_scope_surfaces.reason: Directly constructs ast.TryStar([...], [...], [...], [...]) nodes and feeds them to the internal AST validator (self.stmt(t, '...')). The validator is a private CPython facility not normally invoked by user code — the user would call `ast.parse('try: pass\nexcept* E: pass')` instead. This is a UNIT test of the AST validator's accept/reject logic, not a system test of except*. Excluded per the 'unit test cases are not accepted' rule.

The test class is explicitly about *stack-size stability* — an internal compiler invariant (code.co_stacksize must not depend on how many times a snippet is concatenated). Although the test goes through compile() (public), the assertion target is a CPython-specific implementation detail unrelated to the user-visible except* semantics. The 49 test_except_star.py methods are the canonical system-level coverage; these 3 would only add unit-flavored bookkeeping.

The PR's modification swaps which inputs the test considers 'bad' for ExceptionGroup.subgroup()/split() argument validation. The test does NOT exercise except* — it tests the pre-existing BaseExceptionGroup API (which was added earlier, not by this PR). Out of scope for THIS PR's F2P.

out_of_scope_surfaces.surface: test.test_dis modifications (no new test methods, +22/-30 lines reorganising existing dis tests)
out_of_scope_surfaces.reason: Adjusts existing disassembly tests for new opcode numbering. No new methods to score.

Adds two new check('try:...\nexcept*:...', line, col) assertions to a pre-existing test that asserts SyntaxError offset coordinates. At pre-state, except* parses as a SyntaxError too — but at a different column. Whether the existing method transitions from FAIL → PASS depends on exact pre-state error coordinates that are not stable across CPython versions. Risk of flaky F2P; excluded for safety.

out_of_scope_surfaces.surface: test.test_syntax modification (+100 lines of doctest-style except* error cases)
out_of_scope_surfaces.reason: test_syntax.py uses doctest format to assert specific SyntaxError messages. doctest-driven F2P is tricky to reliably evaluate via unittest.TestLoader; the 49 test_except_star methods + test_unparse roundtrip provide stronger and more directly addressable F2P coverage.

out_of_scope_surfaces.surface: test.test_ast.AST_Tests.test_ast_validation (P2P candidate that turned out to be PR-affected)
out_of_scope_surfaces.reason:
Initially considered as P2P because it doesn't explicitly reference ast.TryStar. End-to-end pre-state validation surfaced that test_ast_validation iterates the module-level exec_tests/single_tests list — the SAME list that test_snippets uses — and the PR added a new entry to that list: `try:
  pass
except* Exception:
  pass`. At pre-state, ast.parse on that snippet raises SyntaxError, ERROR-ing out the whole test_ast_validation method. The method is therefore PR-affected and not a valid P2P. Removed after the first validation run. Could be added to F2P, but the 49 test_except_star methods already provide canonical coverage of except* parser semantics.

eval_tests_patch_notes: eval_tests.patch contains 8 test-file hunks: NEW Lib/test/test_except_star.py (976 lines, the canonical PEP 654 system-test suite), plus modifications to Lib/test/test_ast.py, test_compile.py, test_dis.py, test_exception_group.py, test_exceptions.py, test_syntax.py, and test_unparse.py. Three additional modified test files (test_grammar.py, test_exception_variations.py, test_sys_settrace.py) are deliberately moved to omitted.patch because their modifications add LITERAL except* syntax to method bodies — applying them via eval_tests.patch would prevent the Python interpreter from parsing those modules at pre-state, breaking the P2P candidates we draw from them.
fixture_taint_summary: 50 F2P: 49 from the new Lib/test/test_except_star.py (canonical PEP 654 suite, all SyntaxError-at-import at pre-state because the file uses except* syntax literally) + 1 from test_unparse (ast.parse + ast.unparse round-trip on except* source; AttributeError on ast.TryStar at pre-state). All 50 exercise public language / ast.* surface, no internal symbol leakage. 59 P2P: 37 from Lib/test/test_grammar.py (untouched — file is in omitted.patch) + 22 from Lib/test/test_ast.py (modified by the PR but the chosen methods don't reference ast.TryStar or test_snippets's modified TEST_CASES iteration). Ratio P2P/F2P = 1.18×.

Initial validation run with P2P=60 surfaced one false-positive (test_ast.AST_Tests.test_ast_validation) that ERRORed at pre-state because it iterates the same module-level exec_tests list that test_snippets uses, and the PR added an except* snippet to it. triage.test_level_policy: Augmented F2P selectors use public language, builtin ExceptionGroup, ast, dis, opcode, compile(), and unittest-visible exception behavior. Augmented P2P selectors avoid except* syntax and ExceptionGroup entirely, exercising only pre-existing try/except, exception chaining, ast.unparse regular Try, and sys.exc_info behavior so they pass in base, golden, and mutant states.

test.test_except_star_aug.ExceptionGroup.public_surface: ast.parse, ast.unparse, compile, dis.get_instructions, and opcode.opmap for except* source.
test.test_except_star_aug.ExceptionGroup.rationale: Checks the public AST/unparse/opcode surface for TryStar: unparse must emit except*, PREP_RERAISE_STAR must be public and used by compiled except* code, and invalid TryStar ASTs must be rejected.

test.test_except_star_aug.ExceptionGroup.public_surface: ExceptionGroup.subgroup() and split() with type tuples, predicates, and subclass derive().
test.test_except_star_aug.ExceptionGroup.rationale: Enforces the public partitioning contract: predicates are valid matchers, invalid tuple entries raise TypeError, split returns both match and rest, and subgroup does not derive the discarded complement.

test.test_except_star_aug.ExceptionGroup.public_surface: raise/except* language semantics with ExceptionGroup, naked ValueError, and forbidden ExceptionGroup handlers.
test.test_except_star_aug.ExceptionGroup.rationale: Verifies full group matches are delivered as the original group, naked exceptions are wrapped for except* handlers, and except* refuses ExceptionGroup/BaseExceptionGroup handler types.

requirement_sections: Specification > except* > Raising exceptions in an ``except*`` block
test.test_except_star_aug.ExceptionGroup.public_surface: nested raise/except* flows with bare reraise and unmatched rest propagation.
test.test_except_star_aug.ExceptionGroup.rationale: Asserts recursive leaf routing, naked bare-reraise unwrapping, unmatched rest propagation, and recombination of reraised handled leaves with unmatched leaves.

test.test_except_star_aug.ExceptionGroup.public_surface: try/except*/finally, try/except*/else, new exceptions raised inside except*, and multiple except* handler routing.
test.test_except_star_aug.ExceptionGroup.rationale: Pins standard try semantics around TryStar and verifies except* routes independent subgroups rather than compiling as ordinary try/except.

test.test_except_star_aug.ExceptionGroup.public_surface: compile() on source containing break, continue, and return inside except* blocks.
test.test_except_star_aug.ExceptionGroup.rationale: PEP 654 forbids break, continue, and return from except* blocks. The test compiles representative public source snippets and requires SyntaxError.

requirement_sections: Specification > ExceptionGroup and BaseExceptionGroup > Subclassing Exception Groups
test.test_except_star_aug.ExceptionGroup.public_surface: ExceptionGroup and BaseExceptionGroup constructors, subgroup(), split(), and exception chaining metadata.
test.test_except_star_aug.ExceptionGroup.rationale: Broadens F2P coverage of the public ExceptionGroup object contract: constructor validation, BaseExceptionGroup auto-selection, split/subgroup none and full-match cases, predicate matching, and preserved cause/context metadata on derived subgroups.

test.test_except_star_aug.ExceptionGroup.public_surface: compile() and exec() of valid and invalid Python source using except* handlers, else/finally, tuple matching, and nested control flow.
test.test_except_star_aug.ExceptionGroup.rationale: Covers additional public compile-time and runtime except* shapes that share the modified parser, compiler, and interpreter paths while asserting only PEP 654 user-visible behavior.

test.test_except_star_aug.ExceptionGroup.public_surface: ast.TryStar, ast.ExceptHandler, ast.fix_missing_locations, compile(), exec(), ast.unparse(), and ast.parse().
test.test_except_star_aug.ExceptionGroup.rationale: Exercises the public AST construction, validation, unparse, and reparse path for TryStar without naming CPython internals, including rejection of malformed handlers.

requirement_sections: Specification > except* > Raising exceptions in an ``except*`` block
test.test_except_star_aug.ExceptionGroup.public_surface: except* handler-name binding and cleanup, naked exception no-match propagation, mixed reraise/new-exception groups, runtime handler validation, and compile() of annotated TryStar blocks.
test.test_except_star_aug.ExceptionGroup.rationale: Exercises additional public edge cases in the modified compiler and interpreter paths: handler variable cleanup, replacement exceptions combined with reraised subgroups, invalid runtime handler types, and annotated statements inside TryStar bodies/handlers/else/finally.

test.test_exception_stability_aug.Except.rationale: Guards existing try statement ordering without using except* or ExceptionGroup.

test.test_exception_stability_aug.Except.public_surface: ordinary exception chaining through raise ... from ... and public __cause__/__context__.
test.test_exception_stability_aug.Except.rationale: Pins pre-existing exception chaining metadata outside exception-group handling.

test.test_exception_stability_aug.Except.public_surface: ast.parse and ast.unparse for ordinary try/except source.
test.test_exception_stability_aug.Except.rationale: Ensures the new TryStar unparse path does not alter ordinary Try unparse output.

test.test_exception_stability_aug.Except.public_surface: sys.exc_info() around a handled ordinary exception.
test.test_exception_stability_aug.Except.rationale: Guards pre-existing exception-state restoration behavior outside except*.
